newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Lighting buys Fiberstars stake.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Lighting buys Fiberstars stake.

text.p: Advanced Lighting Technologies Inc and Fiberstars Inc Friday announced Advanced Lighting has acquired an 18 percent stake in Fiberstars.
Advanced Lighting acquired the Fiberstars shares formerly held by Pacific Technology Partners, a venture capital fund that is in the process of dissolving.
Wayne Hellman, chairman and chief executive officer of Advanced Lighting Technologies, will join the Fiberstars Board of Directors.
The two plan to form a strategic partnership to develop and market next generation fiber optic lighting systems.
